title: NovaCorp Performance Review Scoring Rubric
content:
NovaCorp Performance Review Scoring Rubric — Annual Review Cycle FY2025
For Manager Use Only — HR Confidential

REVIEW PERIODS
Mid-year check-in: July (development focused, no rating assigned)
Annual review: December (final rating, compensation input)

RATING SCALE
5 — Exceptional: Consistently exceeds all objectives; demonstrates exemplary behavior; significant impact beyond role scope.
4 — Exceeds Expectations: Meets all and exceeds most objectives; strong competency demonstration.
3 — Meets Expectations: Meets all objectives; demonstrates expected competencies; solid contributor.
2 — Needs Improvement: Partially meets objectives; gaps in key competencies; PIP candidate if sustained.
1 — Does Not Meet Expectations: Fails to meet most objectives; significant performance concerns; immediate action required.

COMPETENCY AREAS (each scored 1 to 5)
A. Results and Accountability: Delivers on commitments; takes ownership; drives outcomes.
B. Collaboration and Teamwork: Works effectively across teams; shares knowledge; constructive in conflict.
C. Innovation and Problem Solving: Brings creative solutions; identifies process improvements.
D. Communication: Clear written and verbal communication; adapts to audience; active listener.
E. Leadership and Development: Develops others (for L4 and above); mentors peers; influences without authority.
F. NovaCorp Values Alignment: Demonstrates integrity, inclusion, customer focus, and continuous learning.

OVERALL RATING CALCULATION
Weighted average of competency scores plus goal achievement. Goal achievement weighted at 60%, competencies at 40%. Fractional scores rounded to nearest 0.5.

COMPENSATION GUIDANCE (HR Use Only)
Rating 5: 8 to 12% merit increase eligible plus equity refresh
Rating 4: 5 to 8% merit increase eligible
Rating 3: 2 to 4% merit increase eligible (cost of living)
Rating 2: 0% merit increase; PIP required
Rating 1: 0% merit increase; termination proceedings may begin

DISTRIBUTION TARGETS
L1 to L3: 15% Exceptional, 35% Exceeds, 40% Meets, 8% Needs Improvement, 2% Does Not Meet
L4 to L7: 10% Exceptional, 30% Exceeds, 45% Meets, 12% Needs Improvement, 3% Does Not Meet
